name: What are the differences between a modular ramp and a custom-built ramp?

mainEntity.name: What are the differences between a modular ramp and a custom-built ramp?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modular ramps are prefabricated, often made from aluminum, and can be assembled quickly without permanent attachment. They are flexible, reusable, and good for temporary or short-term needs. Custom-built ramps, typically made from wood or concrete, are designed to seamlessly integrate with your home's aesthetic and permanent structure. They offer durability and a tailored appearance but require more time for construction and installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modular ramps are pre-made for quick installation, while custom ramps are built on-site to match your home permanently.
